summary: Vivakor, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 2, 2026, disclosing the formation of Monarch Remediation Processing I, LLC (MRP) alongside a Site Operations Agreement with CA-2 Materials, Inc., a Management Services Agreement with Monarch R P Management, LLC, a Guaranty, and an Indemnity Agreement. This is a routine operational agreement establishing a new entity and service arrangements; no special-situation elements—such as acquisitions, divestitures, capital returns, or activist events—are present. The filing contains no deal terms, price per share, or premium. Therefore, this is classified as 'None' (not a special situation).
